item.title: The tactical roguelite, Valor of Man, is coming to Steam in Q1 2026
item.description: "Valor of Man is a turn-based tactics roguelite that distills the combat depth and decision-making of grand RPGs into a focused, replayable format. Developed by Legacy Forge and published by Numskull Games, the game is built for time-friendly sessions while preserving meaningful choice and strategic complexity, and is set to launch on PC via Steam in Q1 2026." - Legacy Forge and Numskull Games.

item.title: The full version of HEART of CROWN is now available via Steam
item.description: "PLAYISM is proud to announce that HEART of CROWN, the deck-building succession battle card game developed by illuCalab., has been fully released on Steam." - PLAYISM.

item.title: The cozy food sim, Foxy Dumplings, is coming to PC and consoles in 2026
item.description: "The indie games developer Soft Crunch Games are today very happy to announce that their cozy food sim, Foxy Dumplings, is coming to PC (via Steam) and consoles (PS5, Xbox Series X, and Nintendo Switch 1 and 2) in 2026." - Jonas Ek, TGG..

item.title: Pokemon Legends: Z-A review - ChristCenteredGamer
item.description: CCG writes - "Pokémon Legends: Z-A is a phenomenal evolution of a classic formula that delivers a great gameplay experience, a fun narrative, and stellar music. However, it suffers from an abysmal technical foundation and an aging identity in sound effects. Despite this, and if youve felt a bit disappointed by recent Pokémon titles, I highly, highly recommend Legends: Z-A. item.title: PS Plus Members Can Save Big on These 20 PS5, PS4 Games in PS Store's January Sale
item.description: Sony is set to kick off an enormous January/Holiday sale on the PS Store soon, but before it gets properly started, PS Plus members have early access to a selection of the deals. If you're currently subscribed, you can nab some discounted games before anyone else. While it's a limited group of PS5 and PS4 games, the big sale starts on 22nd December, so there's not long to wait before there's a heck of a lot more.
